storyBlocks.title: A hundred-year story
storyBlocks.body: A hundred-year-long story does not happen by chance. From a small dairy to a modern Alpine creamery, Monti Trentini has been guided by strong values — family, respect of territory, quality. Casa Finco has made cheese in the Trentino mountains since 1925, four generations of cheesemakers working milk from their own neighborhood within 90 km of the dairy in Grigno. The mountain origin isn't a marketing line; it's the product.

storyBlocks.title: Everything at home
storyBlocks.body: Milk processing, cheese making, aging and packaging take place only in our own plants. That single fact is the quality control: every wheel is handled start to finish by the people who make it, using milk from a 90 km radius in the Trentino mountains and the Asiago plateau. Nothing is outsourced, nothing is anonymous — a certified dairy at 800 metres above sea level, working the way a family creamery has for a century.

storyBlocks.title: Why the mountains matter
storyBlocks.body: Where cows graze in the Dolomites' shades, the milk is different — and so is the cheese. Made at altitude in the Trentino mountains, Monti Trentini's cheeses carry the character of alpine pasture: the herbs, the cool air, the slow seasons. This is authentic Italian Alpine cheese, not generic 'Made in Italy.' The mountain is the difference your customers can taste.

storyBlocks.title: A new taste for the future
storyBlocks.body: We work daily to give the future a new taste. Sustainability drives our choices: a solar plant generating ~650,000 kWh a year used entirely in-house, 80% self-sufficiency for electricity, and roughly 1,000 tons of CO₂ avoided annually. Protecting the alpine landscape supports hundreds of mountain farms and the care of pastures and woodland — the whole mountain community benefits when the cheese is made right.

storyBlocks.title: A partner for your shelves
storyBlocks.body: Monti Trentini brings a complete, authentic Italian Alpine range to specialty and retail shelves — heritage PDO wheels alongside ready-to-merchandise formats, all backed by a hundred-year story shoppers respond to. Happiness has plenty of shapes; we help you put them on the table. A single source from milk to package means consistency you can build a set around.

storyBlocks.title: For the chef's table
storyBlocks.body: For chefs and foodservice, Monti Trentini offers Alpine cheeses with real provenance — aged in the maker's own plants, from milk grazed in the Dolomites' shades. The range spans approachable table cheeses to characterful aged wheels, each with a story worth telling tableside. Authentic, rooted, and made at altitude: the kind of cheese a menu can be built around.
